_comment: Org teams kept as code (design 6.8). apply-rules.py creates or updates each team, sets its members to exactly this list and gives it 'repo_permission' on every managed repo (a team needs access to a repo before it can be asked to review there; a team named in CODEOWNERS needs write, 'push', or GitHub ignores it); verify-settings.py checks all of it, and that every team a managed repo's CODEOWNERS names is listed here with write access. Teams not listed here (design) are left alone.

teams.name: Automation owners
teams.description: Assigned the issues the automation opens and asked to review bot PRs (design 6.8). The software lead for now.
